title: Physicochemical and techno-functional characterization of fibers and powders from leaves of stubble of two cultivars (MD2 and Smooth Cayenne) of pineapple (Ananas comusus L.)
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,1636-1648
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00263J, Paper

Fibers and powders from pineapple stubble have a high water swelling capacity, a high oil retention capacity and K, Ca, P, and Mg with ideal techno-functional and represent a functional and nutritious alternative for the food industry.
